name: Nord Security (NordVPN + Coveron)
priceLabel: Prime $134.85 for the first 15 months ($8.99/mo; renews $296.28/yr) — 27-month Prime is $6.99/mo ($188.73 total)
priceNote: Basic $3.49/mo, Complete $3.99/mo on 27-month term. Identity cover via Coveron (US only): $1M theft insurance + $100K cyber extortion.

features.label: Broker scan
features.norton: Yes — scans supported people-search & data broker sites and shows which have your data

features.label: Automated removal included
features.norton: No — included Privacy Monitor is manual opt-out. Automated removal only with Privacy Monitor Assistant add-on, $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo
features.note: Page by page — nordvpn.com/offer/pricing/ (Nord's pricing page) lists Incogni as 'add at checkout / add-on' on all tiers. nordvpn.com/blog/how-much-does-nordvpn-cost/ (Nord's cost blog) shows Incogni included in Prime only in its table. Used in this comparison: the pricing page (Incogni = add-on), because the pricing page is where the plan is bought.

features.label: Broker count stated
features.norton: Page by page on norton.com — the Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'over 200'; the support list names sites individually with no total. Used in this comparison: 'over 2,000' from the Assistant product page on the main site — the Assistant is the removal product. No staging page is used as a source anywhere in this comparison

features.label: Rescan speed
features.norton: Every 90 days (Privacy Monitor Assistant); Privacy Monitor scan re-run every 3 months

features.label: Custom removal requests
features.norton: Offered via Reputation Defender executive/corporate products only (quote-led, 'when possible', no published price, no consumer product): ExecutivePrivacy — “Custom removal requests, when possible”; Total Radius — “Custom Data Removals”; VIP Services — “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests”. No Norton consumer product offers custom removals — Privacy Monitor Assistant covers its supported broker list only
features.note: Nord sells Incogni as a checkout add-on, but which Incogni tier applies is not stated on nordvpn.com — so custom removals are NOT counted as a named Nord product (gap research, 12 Nov 2026). The named custom-removal companies are 7: Incogni, Optery, DeleteMe, Kanary, PrivacyDuck, OneRep, Privacy Bee.

features.label: Google results removal
features.norton: Yes — via Reputation Defender (separate purchase, reputationdefender.com): “Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them”; its FAQ: “in certain cases online content in your search results can be permanently deleted”. Reputation Defender suppresses negative content in search results and deletes content where possible — it does not make de-indexing requests to Google

features.label: Removal proof
features.norton: Results list + opt-out tracking; email once a batch of opt-outs has been sent. Screenshots: Not stated on official site

features.label: Tracker & cookie blocking
features.norton: Yes — Tracker & Cookie Blocking (support). Full ad blocking: Not stated on official site ('limit targeted ads')
features.rival: Yes — 'ad and tracker blocker' (desktop only); Threat Protection 'blocks tracking cookies'

features.label: Fingerprint protection
features.norton: "Disguise your digital fingerprint automatically each time you browse" — support: anti-fingerprinting will 'return dummy data' to websites

features.label: Email aliases + tracker blocking
features.norton: Yes — create unlimited email aliases (AntiTrack Private Email) and block hidden email trackers
features.rival: Aliases: Not stated on official site. Email protection = link scanning for phishing/malware — tracker blocking Not stated on official site

features.label: App / OS-level protection
features.norton: Yes — Windows OS Tracker Blocking: blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (support)

features.label: Tracking dashboard
features.norton: Yes — Tracking Dashboard shows real-time blocked trackers, ranked by level of concern / risk

gaps.detail: Norton states no cyber-extortion insurance. Checked: LifeLock identity theft insurance, stolen funds reimbursement and scam reimbursement (Advanced $5,000, Total $10,000) - none covers cyber extortion/ransom.
gaps.name: Cyber extortion insurance (Coveron)
gaps.rivalHowSold: Included in Prime only (via Coveron, US only)
gaps.rivalQuote: Up to $100,000 in coverage provided in cyber extortion insurance. NordVPN is not a licensed insurance producer. Benefits under the Master Policy are issued and covered by HSB Specialty Insurance Company.

gaps.detail: Norton states no dedicated IP option for its VPN. Checked: Norton Secure VPN (Standard/Ultimate) - the catalog lists IP Rotation and Double VPN, no dedicated IP.
gaps.name: Dedicated IP
gaps.rivalHowSold: Add-on at checkout on all tiers
gaps.rivalQuote: Dedicated IP. Provides you with a unique IP address that only you can use, improving security and helping you avoid CAPTCHAs. This service is optional, and you can easily add it during checkout.

partials.detail: Norton Cloud Backup stores secure copies of files (2 GB-500 GB by tier, Windows only) - backup, not a general encrypted cloud drive; 1 TB and zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption are not stated.
partials.name: NordLocker (1 TB encrypted cloud storage)

nortonEvidence.note: Included with Norton 360 plans only (not standalone); Windows only; 2 GB-500 GB by tier.
nortonEvidence.quote: Store important files, photos, and documents in the cloud, and easily recover them if your device is lost, stolen, or crashes.

partials.rivalQuote: 1 TB of encrypted cloud storage. Secures all types of files with end-to-end encryption and keeps them handy in a private, zero-knowledge cloud.

partials.detail: Tier packaging, not a product gap: the jobs in Nord's regional tiers are offered by Norton, except the UK GBP 5,000 scam-loss/identity-theft recovery cover (Norton offers scam reimbursement of $5,000-$10,000 on US LifeLock/360 top tiers, but no UK GBP-denominated cover is stated) and the included dedicated IP, which is not stated for Norton.
partials.name: Ultra / Ultimate Max / Complete Max (regional tiers)

nortonEvidence.quote: Helps block your online activities from being tracked

nortonEvidence.product: Norton 360 with LifeLock Ultimate Plus (Scam Protection Pro)

partials.rivalHowSold: Separate regional tiers (not sold in the US)
partials.rivalQuote: Ultra. The Ultra plan is NordVPN's top-tier plan in Canada and most parts of the EU. It includes every benefit you get with Complete and adds Incogni. / Ultimate Max. In those countries, it builds on the Complete plan by including additional features, such as scam loss and ID theft recovery (up to £5,000 each) and a dedicated IP.
